entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I got it about a month ago, and the pulse tracking feature is just not working right.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference in how the data is displayed?

It's definitely a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is completely unreliable. Sometimes it gives readings that are way off, and other times it won't sync the data to my app at all. I think the sensor is just broken.

I see. A device that won't sync is certainly frustrating. It definitely sounds like the unit you received might be defective. Let me pull up your account and see what we can do. Can you confirm the email address on the order?
Thank you. One moment while I review your order details... Okay, I see the order here. You received it 31 days ago. Let me just check our return policy.

Alright, I've got it pulled up. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. Since you're reporting it as defective, I can go ahead and process a full return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's great. I was worried I'd be stuck with it. So I can just send it back for a refund?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email now. Just place the device back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
That's fantastic. That's much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
